question: Select the most appropriate synonym of the word: **EPISTEMIC**
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 2 (Knowledge-related)**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Epistemic"** relates to knowledge or the study of knowledge. It is often used in contexts involving understanding, justification, and the nature of knowledge. (ज्ञान या ज्ञान के अध्ययन से संबंधित) 
 
 
• **Example:** The discussion about scientific theories often involves epistemic questions about how we can know what is true.
 
 
 
• **"Knowledge-related"** refers to anything that is directly associated with or pertains to the concept of knowledge. (ज्ञान-संबंधित)
 
 
• **Example:** His research is primarily focused on knowledge-related issues in artificial intelligence.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the synonym of **'Epistemic'** is **'Knowledge-related'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 2 (Knowledge-related)**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Physical** (भौतिक): Related to the body or physical existence, as opposed to mental or spiritual aspects.
 
 
• **Example:** Physical fitness plays an essential role in overall health.
 
 
 
• **Symbolic** (प्रतीकात्मक): Representing something else, especially an idea, concept, or quality.
 
 
• **Example:** The dove is often used as a symbolic representation of peace.
 
 
 
• **Spatial** (स्थानिक): Relating to space and the relationship of objects within it.
 
 
• **Example:** Architects need a strong understanding of spatial awareness to design functional buildings.
